faqs.question: Do you offer generic per-square-foot pricing?
faqs.answer: No. We productize our pricing based on the vehicle class, coverage requirement, and material engineering. Generic pricing often leads to vendors cutting corners on backing opacity or skipping lamination to hit a budget. We lock in the execution standard and adjust the scope if budget constraints apply.

faqs.question: What is your standard vehicle downtime?
faqs.answer: For standard commercial executions (like 6-wheeler wing vans or closed vans), our verified time-on-asset is 3 to 4 hours per unit. We achieve this by 100% off-site pre-kitting and sequential panel installation.

faqs.question: Can you execute from an existing corporate PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most of our corporate clients supply an approved PDF specification. We act as the translation layer, calibrating that 2D file to the actual physical dimensions, panel seams, and corrugations of your specific fleet assets.

faqs.question: Are you a fully registered vendor?
faqs.answer: Yes. Decal Authority (Decal-Authority-OL Sticker Trading) is fully DTI, BIR, and BMBE registered. We provide complete supporting documentation for your corporate vendor accreditation process upon request.
